visual.summary: Phone and laptop pages both open with the punchline box, show the five-step sequence as one row of boxes with arrows, and end with the closing line; no sideways overflow and no clear house-rule breach visible.

held: ambiguous: The decision "Did we get your dead-end complaint right? Test every link first, say what it's for." could be read as approving the whole five-step path or only the link-testing rule; and "Not quite" only says "say by voice what you meant", so it is unclear what happens to the rule.
